panels.description: Monitored databases whose last collection connected (pgai_mon_source_up = 1).
panels.title: Databases up

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
SELECT t, sum(value) AS value FROM prom_last('pgai_mon_source_up', CAST([] AS VARCHAR[][]), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % ${__interval_ms}) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % ${__interval_ms}) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(${__interval_ms} AS BIGINT))) GROUP BY t
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'up' AS series, '' AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Monitored databases pgai-mon cannot connect to (pgai_mon_source_up = 0).
panels.title: Databases down

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
SELECT t, sum(1 - value) AS value FROM prom_last('pgai_mon_source_up', CAST([] AS VARCHAR[][]), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % ${__interval_ms}) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % ${__interval_ms}) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(${__interval_ms} AS BIGINT))) GROUP BY t
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'down' AS series, '' AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Failed metric queries over the dashboard range, all databases (increase of pgai_mon_errors_total).

panels.description: 1: the database's last collection connected; 0: it did not (pgai_mon_source_up).
panels.title: Database collection status

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
SELECT labels, t, value FROM prom_last('pgai_mon_source_up', CAST([] AS VARCHAR[][]), (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, coalesce(q.labels['dbname'], '') AS series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Wall time of each metric's collection query, the 10 slowest series over the range (pgai_mon_metric_duration_ms).
panels.title: Metric query duration (top 10)

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
WITH x AS (
  SELECT labels, t, value FROM prom_last('pgai_mon_metric_duration_ms', CAST([] AS VARCHAR[][]), (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))
), top AS (
  SELECT labels['cluster'] AS c, labels['node_name'] AS n, labels['dbname'] AS d, labels['metric'] AS m
  FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY max(value) DESC, c, n, d, m LIMIT 10
)
SELECT x.labels, x.t, x.value FROM x JOIN top ON x.labels['cluster'] IS NOT DISTINCT FROM top.c
  AND x.labels['node_name'] IS NOT DISTINCT FROM top.n AND x.labels['dbname'] IS NOT DISTINCT FROM top.d
  AND x.labels['metric'] IS NOT DISTINCT FROM top.m
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, coalesce(q.labels['dbname'], '') || ': ' || coalesce(q.labels['metric'], '') AS series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

SELECT map(['job'], [labels['job']]) AS labels, t, sum(value) AS value FROM prom_last('scrape_samples_scraped', CAST([] AS VARCHAR[][]), (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT))) GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, coalesce(q.labels['job'], '') AS series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time
